spec.name: deploy-tests-off-codex
spec.intent: Re-prove the deploy and adapter tests that use codex as the second harness. census @ 8753f969 (local://what-ships-census.md): 33 lines. harness-shape.test.ts becomes claude vs omp, keeping the property that harnesses differ in home and hook file. init-harness-home.test.ts uses a supported or synthetic home. prune.test.ts proves that the orphan report reads the adapter's agentExt with a synthetic non-.md extension, not a codex tree. omp.test.ts drops the codex roleRouting and unnarrowed comparisons, and KEEPS its verbatim quote of omp's own 'Claude/Codex-compatible' doc comment. signify-marker-class.test.ts drops the codex dir-name history. runtime-config.test.ts uses a non-harness name for the unconfigured case. Do not touch the codex adapter.
accept: `git grep -n -i codex -- <the 6 outputs>` prints exactly one line: omp.test.ts quoting omp's 'Claude/Codex-compatible' doc comment. At 8753f969 it prints 33.

`pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge exec vitest run test/deploy test/adapters/omp.test.ts test/catalog/signify-marker-class.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/runtime exec vitest run test/runtime-config.test.ts` are green.
harness-shape.test.ts still fails if two registered harnesses shared home, extension and hook file. Prove this by the return citing the assertion.
`pnpm exec biome check` passes on the outputs.
